title: Chapter 94: Army Ants
content:
Chapter 94: Army Ants

However, the "ammunition" is limited, with only 10 bronze spears and 200 black iron spears.

"We must use it sparingly." He sighed softly.

"Li Jianguo, you three brothers come here. This bronze crossbow cart will be handed over to you three brothers."

"Yes, Lord!"

In the sky, the bald eagle boss made a loud cry and then released his claws.

Mosifu fell directly into the herd of beasts and was eaten in a few breaths.

This tragic scene shocked many people in the territory!

The warriors who had killed wild beasts and seen blood were obviously much calmer.

Wang Shuo glanced at Li Jianguo and his three brothers with his peripheral vision. They had already placed the crossbow cart.

The bronze crossbow cart was comparable to a Hummer, and the bronze spears were as thick as a baby's arm and were two meters long.

The huge elasticity of the mechanism required two people with a strength of at least 20 points to be able to pull it.

After loading the bronze spear, Wang Shuo pointed at the arrogant bald eagle boss in the sky: "Shoot hard."

"Remember, this crossbow car only kills bosses and elite monsters, don't waste the spear." Wang Shuo reminded again.

"Yes, Lord."

When the bald eagle boss dived again, Li Jianguo immediately aimed at it.

"Fire."

The bronze spear, as thick as a baby's arm, was like a missile that broke through the air. It flew towards the bald eagle boss at a lightning speed with a sound of breaking through the air.

In the blink of an eye, it pierced its body.

"-2000"

A huge blood-red number suddenly appeared above its head.

"Ying..."

The bald eagle felt pain and kept making mournful cries, and a splash of blood fell from the air.

It originally wanted to dive down again and catch a hapless guy.

After this blow, it immediately circled into the air and did not dare to attack easily.

"Well done!" Wang Shuo couldn't help but praise.

"Kill."

"Kill."

"Kill."

This attack also greatly boosted morale, and many people shouted loudly.

Just when everyone was in high spirits, a black torrent surged over from a distance.

Wang Shuo looked carefully and looked serious.

[Army Ants]

[Level: Level 5]

[Attack Power: 10]

[Defense Power: 0]

[Health: 350]

[Skill: Corrosive Bite]

[Evaluation: Although ants are weak, they can bite elephants to death! ]

What a joke?

How can we kill all these secretive things?

It is estimated that there are at least a million of them.

Soon, the ant army had reached the city wall.

Wang Shuo thought that these ants with extremely low attack power were not a threat at all.

But the ant army slapped Wang Shuo in the face with its strength!

In a very short time, the wall was covered with army ants.

Moreover, every ant can cause 1 point of durability loss to the light wall every second.

Wang Shuo's heart was beating wildly.

The durability of the city wall was dropping wildly!

This is really outrageous. His mother opened the door to outrageousness - outrageous to the extreme!

If the city wall could speak, it would definitely say: "Ant, are you serious? Your small mouth can cause such great damage to me."

"Prepare tung oil." Wang Shuo immediately realized the seriousness of the problem.

The logistics team immediately took out the wood, sprinkled it with tung oil, and then handed it to the combatants.

Seeing the dark "ant wall" in front of him, Wang Shuo's eyelids jumped and he couldn't wait to roar: "Quick, light it!"

Suddenly, a circle of flames burned outside the city wall.

The raging fire continued to burn, causing several points of damage to the ants every second.

Wang Shuo finally breathed a sigh of relief. Although the damage caused was not high, it would last.

More importantly, the ants were swept down by the burning logs, and the number of ants that could cause damage to the city wall was reduced by more than half.

But the durability of the city wall was still decreasing.

This made Wang Shuo a little worried.

He thought about it and planned to summon mud puppets from the mud pit to share the pressure of the city wall.
